#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <set>
#include <ctime>
#define eps 1e-6
#define LL long long
#define pii pair<int, int>
using namespace std;

const LL mod = 1e9 + 7;
int n;
LL p, k;
map<LL, LL> s;
LL fa[1000100];
int Find(LL x) {
    if(x != fa[x]) return fa[x] = Find(fa[x]);
    return x;
} 

int cnt[1001000];
int main() {
    cin >> p >> k;
    s[0] = 1;
    LL ans = 1;
    if(k==0) {
        for(int i = 1; i < p; i++) ans = (ans * p) % mod;
        cout << ans;
        return 0;
    }
    for(int i = 0; i < p; i++) fa[i] = i;
    for(int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        LL shit = (k * i) % p;
        int x1 = Find(i), x2 = Find(shit);
        fa[x1] = x2;
    }
    for(int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        int z = Find(i);
        cnt[z]++;
    }
    for(int i = 1; i < p; i++)
        if(cnt[i]) ans = (ans * p) % mod;
    if(k == 1) ans = (ans * p) % mod;
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
